submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Produce exactly ONE full square transparent RGBA native >=1024 sprite, editing image1 only. This is the ice sword girl's NE run frame08 between image2 (NE07) and image3 (NE09), each 75ms. Image4 is the primary approved soft polished hand-painted Daoist chibi style only.
CHANGE ONLY BOTH SHOULDER-SLEEVE-ELBOW-WRIST CHAINS AND THEIR HELD OBJECT POSITIONS into a true halfway returning-arm pose. In image2 the anatomical RIGHT sword arm is extended fully backward/left; image3 is forward/right. Image1 currently stays at the backward endpoint too long and then snaps forward. Frame08 must bring the right upper arm, bent elbow and sword grip forward partway, with the grip naturally close beside the near waist/hip midway between those two frames, not still at full backward reach and not yet fully forward. Keep the same anatomical RIGHT hand gripping the sword. Lower the sword blade through a natural intermediate carrying angle broadly downward in clear space outside the thighs, rather than flipping the blade instantly from rear-left to high front-right. Preserve sword shape and blade length, no blade through the body or legs, floating grip, hand reversal or detached forearm.
Move the anatomical LEFT talisman hand partway BACK from the forward extended image2 pose toward the behind-body image3 pose. Its elbow, sleeve and blue rectangular talisman are now closer beside the far torso, with natural partial occlusion if needed; do not leave the talisman at full forward reach. One continuous shoulder-to-upperarm-to-elbow-to-wrist chain for each arm. Exactly one sword in the right hand and one blue talisman in the left.
LOCK EVERYTHING ELSE TO IMAGE1: head, face, brown highbun/long hair, blue-white-gold costume, torso/pelvis, hip and thigh origins, both knees/shins/ankles/boots and their exact pose and positions, body position, NE camera, full-canvas scale and framing. The anatomical LEFT leg remains in its current rear forefoot-supported stance with raised heel; the anatomical RIGHT leg remains airborne bent and coming forward exactly as image1. Do not re-pose or move any leg/foot to accommodate the arm edit. Preserve the coherent hip-thigh-knee-shin-ankle-toe travel plane, no outward toe twist, splay, pelvis rotation or leg length change. Natural knee flexion, perspective and normal visible raised sole remain. Two arms, two legs, one sword, one talisman. No extra anatomy, full-character translation, rescaling, crop, mirror, text, background, shadow or grid; true alpha transparency.
